entries.description: Record the relaxation in `AGENTS.md`, above the managed fence: ground rules 1 and 4 are suspended for sets 142–145, the +33% envelope replaces them with its four numbers, and the two surviving rules (one test per behavior; a new module must shrink another) are stated. A staff session reading only `AGENTS.md` must see the real constraint, not a stale ceiling.

Implement deterministic affected-test selection from changed paths, module ownership, dependency edges, and configured repository rules. Every selection carries the named reason that produced it; a changed path that maps to nothing records `selection_unknown` and raises risk rather than widening the run.
Extend `test_evidence.py` with the closed stage vocabulary `preverify-targeted` and `final-full`. Only `final-full` can satisfy `test_run_fresh`, and it binds to the tree digest it ran against.
Affected tests before verification; the full suite once, after.
Session 1 registered; working directly on experiment/verification-pipeline-v3 per the 141 operator deviation.
AGENTS.md now states the +33% envelope above the managed fence; rules 1 and 4 marked suspended for sets 142-145, surviving rules stated.
ai_router/affected.py: changed-test, module-ownership, configured-rule and dependency-edge reasons; unmapped paths record selection_unknown and pull smoke tests instead of widening.
Closed stage vocabulary preverify-targeted/final-full; only final-full satisfies test_run_fresh, and it binds to the tree digest it ran against.
VERIFIED by gpt-5.5/openai over copilot-cli in round 2; round 1 blocking finding was an uncollected test-support file treated as mapped.
Targeted run (10 of 22 files, 217 tests) before verification; full suite 464 passed recorded as final-full after the last change.
Session 1 closed VERIFIED; five gates green.
